nodes.name: main.yml
nodes.summary: CI pipeline that builds and tests the Stylo project on Linux, macOS, and Windows using the `servo` feature, with an aggregated build-result job that reports success only when all platform builds pass.
nodes.languageNotes: GitHub Actions workflow with 5 jobs including a status-aggregation result job using `needs.*.result` expressions.

nodes.name: mirror-to-release-branch.yml
nodes.summary: Automatically mirrors the main branch to a date-based release branch on every push, using the first Servo downstream commit hash to derive the branch name.

nodes.name: sync-upstream.yml
nodes.summary: Scheduled daily workflow that synchronizes the repository with mozilla-central upstream by running the sync.sh script and pushing changes to an upstream tracking branch.
